title: Lookalike pair: same name, two PANs, same city
evidence_note: Two unrelated Mumbai proprietorships: 27AXEPG3338E1ZR (Sewree) and 27AOHPP0337G1Z0 (Ghatkopar), per knowyourgst.com / justdial. Discovery should find both PANs. Live search (22 Nov 2026) instead returns other near-identical names, e.g. 24ANWPP5595N2ZR (Ahmedabad) and 07BVSPS5329G1ZZ (Delhi): still several PANs, still Refer.
